generatedProse.practice-connection: In the School of Sport, writing within your subject is what the later stages of a degree reward, and what research and professional practice demand. Every lab report, essay, coaching log, case study and journal submission is judged partly on whether it reads like the work of someone inside the subject. Treat what follows as being about your own writing in sport, its conventions, its sources and its critical edge, not about writing in the abstract.
